samples.xml_description:
<module id="alu">
    <description>Implement an ALU for a 32-bit MIPS-ISA CPU.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="a" width_description="[31:0]">A 32-bit input operand.</input>
        <input id="b" width_description="[31:0]">A 32-bit input operand.</input>
        <input id="aluc" width_description="[5:0]">A 6-bit control signal for selecting the operation to be performed.</input>
        <output id="r" width_description="[31:0]">A 32-bit output representing the result of the operation.</output>
        <output id="zero">A 1-bit output indicating whether the result is zero.</output>
        <output id="carry">A 1-bit output indicating whether a carry occurred during the operation.</output>
        <output id="negative">A 1-bit output indicating whether the result is negative.</output>
        <output id="overflow">A 1-bit output indicating whether an overflow occurred during the operation.</output>
        <output id="flag">A 1-bit output representing a general flag, which is set based on specific operations (SLT and SLTU).</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="ADD">6'b100000</parameter>
        <parameter id="ADDU">6'b100001</parameter>
        <parameter id="SUB">6'b100010</parameter>
        <parameter id="SUBU">6'b100011</parameter>
        <parameter id="AND">6'b100100</parameter>
        <parameter id="OR">6'b100101</parameter>
        <parameter id="XOR">6'b100110</parameter>
        <parameter id="NOR">6'b100111</parameter>
        <parameter id="SLT">6'b101010</parameter>
        <parameter id="SLTU">6'b101011</parameter>
        <parameter id="SLL">6'b000000</parameter>
        <parameter id="SRL">6'b000010</parameter>
        <parameter id="SRA">6'b000011</parameter>
        <parameter id="SLLV">6'b000100</parameter>
        <parameter id="SRLV">6'b000110</parameter>
        <parameter id="SRAV">6'b000111</parameter>
        <parameter id="LUI">6'b001111</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description>
        <sequential_logic id="res">
            <description>combinational logic operation.</description>
            <implementation>
                <case>
                    <when id="ADD">
                        <sequential>assign</sequential>
                        <description>combinational logic operation.</description>
                        <implementation>a + b</implementation>
                    </when>
                    <when id="ADDU">
                        <sequential>assign</sequential>
                        <description>combinational logic operation.</description>
                        <implementation>a + b</implementation>
                    </when>
                    <when id="SUB">
                        <sequential>assign</sequential>
                        <description>combinational logic operation.</description>
                        <implementation>a - b</implementation>
                    </when>
                    <when id="SUBU">
                        <sequential>assign</sequential>
                        <description>combinational logic operation.</description>
                        <implementation>a - b</implementation>
                    </when>
                    <when id="AND">
                        <sequential>assign</sequential>
                        <description>combinational logic operation.</description>
                        <implementation>a & b</implementation>
                    </when>
                    <when id="OR">
                        <sequential>assign</sequential>
                        <description>combinational logic operation.</description>
                        <implementation>a | b</implementation>
                    </when>
                    <when id="XOR">
                        <sequential>assign</sequential>
                        <description>combinational logic operation.</description>
                        <implementation>a ^ b</implementation>
                    </when>
                    <when id="NOR">
                        <sequential>assign</sequential>
                        <description>combinational logic operation.</description>
                        <implementation>~(a | b)</implementation>
                    </when>
                    <when id="SLT">
                        <sequential>assign</sequential>
                        <description>combinational logic operation.</description>
                        <implementation>($signed(a) < $signed(b)) ? 1 : 0</implementation>
                    </when>
                    <when id="SLTU">
                        <sequential>assign</sequential>
                        <description>combinational logic operation.</description>
                        <implementation>(a < b) ? 1 : 0</implementation>
                    </when>
                    <when id="SLL">
                        <sequential>assign</sequential>
                        <description>combinational logic operation.</description>
                        <implementation>b << a</implementation>
                    </when>
                    <when id="SRL">
                        <sequential>assign</sequential>
                        <description>combinational logic operation.</description>
                        <implementation>b >> a</implementation>
                    </when>
                    <when id="SRA">
                        <sequential>assign</sequential>
                        <description>combinational logic operation.</description>
                        <implementation>$signed(b) >>> a</implementation>
                    </when>
                    <when id="SLLV">
                        <sequential>assign</sequential>
                        <description>combinational logic operation.</description>
                        <implementation>b << a[4:0]</implementation>
                    </when>
                    <when id="SRLV">
                        <sequential>assign</sequential>
                        <description>combinational logic operation.</description>
                        <implementation>b >> a[4:0]</implementation>
                    </when>
                    <when id="SRAV">
                        <sequential>assign</sequential>
                        <description>combinational logic operation.</description>
                        <implementation>$signed(b) >>> a[4:0]</implementation>
                    </when>
                    <when id="LUI">
                        <sequential>assign</sequential>
                        <description>combinational logic operation.</description>
                        <implementation>{a[15:0], 16'b0}</implementation>
                    </when>
                    <else>
                        <sequential>assign</sequential>
                        <description>combinational logic operation.</description>
                        <implementation>33'b0</implementation>
                    </else>
                </case>
            </implementation>
        </sequential_logic>
        <combinational_logic id="zero">
            <description>combinational logic operation.</description>
            <implementation>
                <if>
                    <condition>res == 33'b0</condition>
                    <then>
                        <description>combinational logic operation.</description>
                        <implementation>assign zero = 1'b1</implementation>
                    </then>
                    <else>
                        <description>combinational logic operation.</description>
                        <implementation>assign zero = 1'b0</implementation>
                    </else>
                </if>
            </implementation>
        </combinational_logic>
        <combinational_logic id="carry">
            <description>combinational logic operation.</description>
            <implementation>
                <if>
                    <condition>aluc == ADD</condition>
                    <then>
                        <description>combinational logic operation.</description>
                        <implementation>assign carry = res[32]</implementation>
                    </then>
                    <elseif>
                        <condition>aluc == ADDU</condition>
                        <then>
                            <description>combinational logic operation.</description>
                            <implementation>assign carry = res[32]</implementation>
                        </then>
                    </elseif>
                    <elseif>
                        <condition>aluc == SUB</condition>
                        <then>
                            <description>combinational logic operation.</description>
                            <implementation>assign carry = res[32]</implementation>
                        </then>
                    </elseif>
                    <elseif>
                        <condition>aluc == SUBU</condition>
                        <then>
                            <description>combinational logic operation.</description>
                            <implementation>assign carry = res[32]</implementation>
                        </then>
                    </elseif>
                    <else>
                        <description>combinational logic operation.</description>
                        <implementation>assign carry = 1'b0</implementation>
                    </else>
                </if>
            </implementation>
        </combinational_logic>
        <combinational_logic id="overflow">
            <description>combinational logic operation.</description>
            <implementation>
                <if>
                    <condition>aluc == ADD</condition>
                    <then>
                        <description>combinational logic operation.</description>
                        <implementation>
                            <if>
                                <condition>{a[31], b[31], ~res[31]}</condition>
                                <then>
                                    <description>combinational logic operation.</description>
                                    <implementation>assign overflow = 1'b1</implementation>
                                </then>
                                <elseif>
                                    <condition>{~a[31], ~b[31], res[31]}</condition>
                                    <then>
                                        <description>combinational logic operation.</description>
                                        <implementation>assign overflow = 1'b1</implementation>
                                    </then>
                                </elseif>
                                <else>
                                    <description>combinational logic operation.</
